question: Change in the inventory of a firm is treated as ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Investment.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Change in inventory** is treated as an** investment** because it represents the amount of money the firm has tied up in its inventory.
